presentation.summary: Submit Silo movie and series requests directly to a riven-ts instance.
presentation.description_markdown: Connects Silo to [riven-ts](https://github.com/rivenmedia/riven-ts) through its GraphQL `requestItem` API, so requests are fulfilled without Seerr. riven-ts finds and downloads the item itself. The plugin submits the request and reports status from the request's primary media item. Movies need a TMDB id and series need a TVDB id. riven-ts reports nothing back about duplicates or rejections, so a request that riven-ts drops stays queued.
presentation.setup_markdown: Set `RIVEN_SETTING__apiKey` on riven-ts to a key of at least 32 characters. If it is unset, riven-ts generates a new key on every start. In Silo, add a Riven request server with riven-ts's base URL and that key, then route movies and series to it in request routing. The plugin sends the key as `Authorization: Bearer`. riven-ts listens on port 3000 by default, and on localhost only unless you set `RIVEN_SETTING__host=0.0.0.0`. If Silo and riven-ts run in separate Docker Compose projects, use `http://host.docker.internal:3000` or a shared Docker network instead of `http://localhost:3000`. riven-ts scans finished downloads into Silo through its own Silo plugin, `@repo/plugin-silo`, not through this plugin.

capabilities.description: Fulfill content requests directly against a riven-ts instance's GraphQL API.
